profile.headline: Technical Lead for Unpage @ Aptible
profile.summary: I'm a technical leader looking to leverage technology to change the face of healthcare. I love building high-performance teams and working with them to design and build systems to solve the hardest problems in healthcare.

positions.title: Staff Engineer & Systems Architect
positions.description: Skills: SDK development · Django · API Development · Application Architecture · Python

positions.title: Database Administrator, Web Developer
positions.description:
Database entry and maintenance on a small MS Access database containing mission-critical member, customer, and company information. 

Redesigned the database schema for aforementioned database, and ported data to a more flexible database management system (MySQL). 

Redesigned the company website using the Wordpress platform in 2009. 

Redesigned the company website again in 2012 using Ruby on Rails and the Heroku cloud deployment platform.

Created a geolocation tool for the company members to be placed on a Google Map on the company website, including a backend for adding, modifying, and removing members.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Worked with a team of 8-10 developers on an internal healthcare management application, based on the Java EE, IBM WebSphere, and DB2 9/10 stack.

Designed and built a replacement for the member correspondence and letter generation system using Apache Velocity, HTML, and CSS, resulting in a 500% increase in resource efficiency, and a 300% increase in speed when generating PDFs.

Trained other developers in project-specific development practices in the letter generation codebase. Average development time per letter decreased from four days to two hours.

Implemented features and bugfixes for legacy parts of the system using Struts 2.0 and JSP.

positions.title: Senior Developer, Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Managed a team of four developers to meet the requirements and deadlines of more than 30 projects for numerous external clients.

Worked directly with the company president to assess customer requirements for software development and provide estimates of effort.

Directed large-scale deployments of both custom and existing software both in-house and on client campuses.

Instituted a number of processes and workflows for the development team, including the integration of the git source control system and a continuous integration server “cijoe”.

Promoted productivity via the introduction of an Agile workflow akin to the “eXtreme Programming” (XP) methodology, resulting in a 30% decrease in development time.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Produced multiple prototypes for the company flagship product, Link, to manage the warehouse workflow for the document storage division.

Designed and developed a public interface for Link, called Link Lite, for use by new document storage customers.

Implemented Tesseract OCR and ElasticSearch for Link Lite, allowing customers to search their documents from the web using keywords.

Built custom software for clients, including administration software for two large public school districts, and multiple Drupal- and WordPress-based websites.

Worked with the Dell OpenStack team to investigate and implement a proof-of-concept scaling solution for our computation-heavy OCR component of Link.

positions.title: Network Administrator, Web Developer
positions.description:
Redesigned the church network infrastructure to better suit the needs of the organization, including the introduction of Active Directory.

Administered Active Directory to deploy applications and other group policies to meet users’ needs on an individual basis.

positions.title: Systems Administrator, Developer
positions.description:
Managed a large number of diverse library systems for a multitude of state institutions, including the State Library of PA, and the State Hospital. 

Installed, configured and maintained systems hosted in the Shippensburg University datacenter to ensure redundancy, fault tolerance, and overall operability. 

Daily tasks included log inspection (and correcting identified problems) and issue management using tools like MantisBT. 

Modified existing applications to meet the needs of the varying organizations, including multiple open-source projects and in-house solutions. 

Wrote interfaces for existing, closed-source software to make management easier. 

Improved organization workflow by automating tasks with Shell and Perl scripts.

positions.title: Junior Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked on an ongoing modification of an open-source project, called Vufind, to support campus library operations.

Wrote in Java, PHP, SQL, jQuery, SMARTY, Shell, Perl, C, and others to make required changes to both the frontend and backend functionality.
